info.title: Engineering Project Development Tool — REST API
info.description:
REST API for the Engineering Project Development Tool — an AI-powered, certification-native platform for the engineering lifecycle (Requirements -> System Functions -> Architecture -> Verification -> Certification).

All endpoints are mounted under `/api/v1`. Every endpoint returns the standard response envelope: `{ success: true, data, message? }` on success, `{ success: false, error }` on failure. Most endpoints require a JWT bearer token (`Authorization: Bearer <token>`); the MCP Streamable HTTP surface (`/mcp`) authenticates with a scoped API key instead.

This document is generated from `@openapi` JSDoc annotations on the route files. The first tranche (auth, requirements, baselines, verification, certification) is fully annotated; the remaining route files are back-filled in follow-on work.

post.description: Create a new user account and return a session JWT. Public — no authentication required. The first user created on a fresh deployment (or any user whose email is in `ADMIN_EMAILS`) becomes an admin. Rate-limited to 10 attempts per 15-minute window.

201.description: Account created. Returns the user and a session JWT.

post.summary: Log in and obtain a session JWT
post.description: Authenticate with email + password and return a session JWT. Public — no authentication required. Rate-limited to 10 attempts per 15-minute window.

200.description: Authenticated. Returns the user and a session JWT.

post.description: Trigger a password-reset email for the given address. Public — no authentication required. Always returns 200 with the same generic message regardless of whether the email exists, to avoid leaking which addresses are registered. Rate-limited.

200.description: Generic acknowledgement (sent whether or not the address exists).

example.message: If that email is registered, a reset link has been sent.

post.summary: Re-authenticate for a signing event (CFR 21 Part 11)
post.description: Re-enter the account password to mint a short-lived (60-second) re-authentication token. Required by CFR 21 Part 11 signing endpoints — the caller must already hold a valid session JWT, and the re-auth token is then sent as the `X-Reauth-Token` header on the sign-off request. Rate-limited like `/login`.

401.description: Missing session token, or the supplied password is wrong.

get.description: Return the profile of the user identified by the session JWT.

get.description: List every user account. Admin-only — the controller rejects non-admin callers with 403.
